name: idle-backstop-guard
description: Refuses to end a turn while the session has open fleet children or watcher items and no server-side check-in (send_later / create_trigger) will fire within 35 minutes: the in-process timers that watch them stop while the session idles (LC-2043). Also (LC-2167, enforced from 2026-11-17) requires that a session leaving an open deliverable (fleet child, watch, or a PR it opened) names its next owner in the final reply, or carries the operator's written abandon. Fails open; child sessions get a toast only.
